about_the_game:
Ready to dive into the thrilling world of the gaming industry? In "Game Dream Journey", you'll start from the dawn of game consoles in 1976, personally participating in and witnessing every revolution and rise of the gaming industry. Grow from an unknown small workshop to a pivotal industry giant, step by step!

---

  • Start from scratch and build your game empire with your own hands! Construct various functional areas like development rooms, break rooms, meeting rooms, and graphics studios, and cleverly arrange various facilities to make your studio operate efficiently. As your business develops, continuously expand your territory and unlock more possibilities!

  • Recruit and cultivate your employees, each possessing different abilities and traits. As an excellent leader, your task is to assign them to the most suitable positions, allowing them to utilize their strengths and maximize their potential. Don't forget, treat your employees well and meet their needs; they will be your most valuable asset on the road to success!

  • Every decision is crucial! Utilize the company decision system to adjust your development strategy in real-time according to market conditions. Every choice you make will profoundly impact the company's future direction, leading it to glory or facing challenges – all in your hands.

  • It's time to unleash your creativity and craft your dream game! From game genre and theme to adjusting various design weights, you need to repeatedly deliberate to find the best combination. Only by achieving higher game ratings can your work explode in the market and achieve sales legendary status!

  • To develop your own engine or license one from competitors? This is a question that requires careful consideration. As time progresses, you must continuously invest in research and development, master cutting-edge technologies and features, and constantly optimize your engine to stay ahead in fierce market competition, develop even better games, and even earn substantial profits through engine licensing!

  • When your masterpiece is released, it's time to launch it worldwide! Set a highly competitive price and fully engage in marketing activities to make more players aware of and purchase your game, eventually becoming loyal fans of your studio!

  • Always pay attention to market trends and accurately grasp the release timing for your next game; this is often the key to success or failure.

  • Insufficient initial funds? You can undertake various contract jobs to accumulate initial capital. Remember, a good company reputation will be key to securing high-value contracts and a stepping stone to your success!

  • By holding meetings in the meeting room for reviews or brainstorming, you'll not only gain valuable market feedback reports but also acquire research points accumulated by employees, laying the foundation for future innovation.

  • Think your employees aren't perfect enough? Establish training rooms for them to attend courses, invest in the future, and your efforts will always pay off! You can also use rare items to change employee traits or ability caps, building an impeccable, perfect development team!

  • A large amount of charts and data will help you deeply analyze the market, understand your competitors, and gain a competitive advantage to stand out! Every success of yours will be recorded in history, because the history of games will be written by you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 750Ti

short_description: Forge Your Dream Games, Build a Legendary Studio! Unearth and cultivate talented employees, leading your team through countless critical decisions as you rise from obscurity to claim the coveted Game of the Year award. This is your path to becoming a legend. Are you ready to write your own chapter?
